package streamidentity_test

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	events "example.com/streamidentity/gen/events"
	rpc "example.com/streamidentity/gen/rpcevents"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type (
	httpStream struct {
		value *events.Chunk
	}
	rpcStream struct {
		value *rpc.Chunk
	}
	httpAudit struct {
		t *testing.T
	}
	rpcAudit struct {
		t *testing.T
	}
)

func TestOptionalStreamingFields(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("http", func(t *testing.T) {
		chunk := &events.Chunk{}
		endpoint := loom.Endpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
			return httpStream{chunk}, nil
		})
		client := events.NewClient(nil, endpoint, httpAudit{t})
		stream, err := client.WatchStream(context.Background(), &events.WatchPayload{})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		got, err := stream.Recv()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Same(t, chunk, got)
		require.NotNil(t, got.Value)
		require.Equal(t, "written", *got.Value)
		require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
	})
	t.Run("jsonrpc", func(t *testing.T) {
		chunk := &rpc.Chunk{}
		endpoint := loom.Endpoint(func(context.Context, any) (any, error) {
			return rpcStream{chunk}, nil
		})
		client := rpc.NewClient(nil, endpoint, rpcAudit{t})
		stream, err := client.WatchStream(context.Background(), &rpc.WatchPayload{})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		got, err := stream.RecvWithContext(context.Background())
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Same(t, chunk, got)
		require.NotNil(t, got.Value)
		require.Equal(t, "written", *got.Value)
		require.NoError(t, stream.Close())
	})
}

func (s httpStream) Recv() (*events.Chunk, error) {
	return s.value, nil
}
func (s httpStream) RecvWithContext(context.Context) (*events.Chunk, error) {
	return s.value, nil
}
func (httpStream) Close() error {
	return nil
}
func (s rpcStream) Recv() (*rpc.Chunk, error) {
	return s.value, nil
}
func (s rpcStream) RecvWithContext(context.Context) (*rpc.Chunk, error) {
	return s.value, nil
}
func (rpcStream) Close() error {
	return nil
}
func (a httpAudit) Audit(ctx context.Context, i *events.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	res, err := next(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return res, err
	}
	value := i.ClientStreamingResult(res)
	require.Empty(a.t, value.Value())
	value.SetValue("written")
	return res, nil
}
func (a rpcAudit) Audit(ctx context.Context, i *rpc.AuditInfo, next loom.Endpoint) (any, error) {
	res, err := next(ctx, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return res, err
	}
	value := i.ClientStreamingResult(res)
	require.Empty(a.t, value.Value())
	value.SetValue("written")
	return res, nil
}
